description: SpecStream is a live-web data engine that finds, extracts, enriches, and monitors structured data from the web for teams and agents. It offers web search, page extraction, and larger quoted data-collection jobs, with results carrying source URLs and read times.
summary: SpecStream exposes a REST API at api.specstream.ai, a remote OAuth/API-key protected MCP server, and a Python-installed `specstream` CLI; docs also describe a separate no-account paid agent purchase flow that returns per-purchase bearer tokens for polling purchased jobs.
